comparison.objective: Orient a pressure-relief cushion correctly and fit it flat into a wheelchair.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize functional orientation, execute two quarter turns with regrasping, and lower into side clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Correct orientation within 20 degrees, flat and positioned in the seat; wrong orientation scores zero.
comparison.reason: Reorientation and constrained placement are unrelated to impact fracture and complete debris containment.
